title: CVE-2021-43890: Microsoft Windows AppX Installer Spoofing Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows AppX Installer contains a spoofing vulnerability which has a high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

title: CVE-2021-4102: Google Chromium V8 Use-After-Free Vulnerability

title: CVE-2021-44515: Zoho Desktop Central Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
summary: Zoho Desktop Central contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the Desktop Central MSP server.

title: CVE-2019-13272: Linux Kernel Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
summary: Kernel/ptrace.c in Linux kernel mishandles contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows local users to obtain root access.

title: CVE-2021-35394: Realtek Jungle SDK Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: RealTek Jungle SDK contains multiple memory corruption vulnerabilities which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

title: CVE-2019-7238: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager Incorrect Access Control Vulnerability
summary: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager before 3.15.0 has an incorrect access control vulnerability. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

title: CVE-2019-0193: Apache Solr DataImportHandler Code Injection Vulnerability
summary: The optional Apache Solr module DataImportHandler contains a code injection vulnerability.

title: CVE-2021-44168: Fortinet FortiOS Arbitrary File Download
summary: Fortinet FortiOS "execute restore src-vis" downloads code without integrity checking, allowing an attacker to arbitrarily download files.

title: CVE-2017-17562: Embedthis GoAhead Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Embedthis GoAhead before 3.6.5 allows remote code execution if CGI is enabled and a CGI program is dynamically linked.

title: CVE-2017-12149: Red Hat JBoss Application Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: The JBoss Application Server, shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Application Platform 5.2, allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted serialized data.

title: CVE-2010-1871: Red Hat Linux JBoss Seam 2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: JBoss Seam 2 (jboss-seam2), as used in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3.0 for Red Hat Linux, allows attackers to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability can only be exploited when the Java Security Manager is not properly configured.

title: CVE-2020-17463: Fuel CMS SQL Injection Vulnerability
summary: FUEL CMS 1.4.7 allows SQL Injection via the col parameter to /pages/items, /permissions/items, or /navigation/items.

title: CVE-2020-8816: Pi-Hole AdminLTE Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Pi-hole Web v4.3.2 (aka AdminLTE) allows Remote Code Execution by privileged dashboard users via a crafted DHCP static lease.

title: CVE-2019-10758: MongoDB mongo-express Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: mongo-express before 0.54.0 is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via endpoints that uses the `toBSON` method.

title: CVE-2021-44228: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability where JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled JNDI-related endpoints, allowing for remote code execution.

title: CVE-2018-14847: MikroTik Router OS Directory Traversal Vulnerability

summary: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11302 is vulnerable to authentication bypass that allows a few REST-API URLs without authentication

title: CVE-2021-40438: Apache HTTP Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
summary: A crafted request uri-path can cause mod_proxy to forward the request to an origin server choosen by the remote user. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server 2.4.48 and earlier.

title: CVE-2021-44077: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11306, ServiceDesk Plus MSP before 10530, and SupportCenter Plus before 11014 are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution

title: Supreme Court: Whole Woman’s Health v. Jackson
summary: A pre-enforcement challenge under the Federal Constitution to Texas Senate Bill 8—the Texas Heartbeat Act—may proceed past the motion to dismiss stage against certain of the named defendants but not others; the order of the District Court is affirmed in part and reversed in part, and the case is remanded. (No. 21-463, opinion by Justice Gorsuch; 595 U.S. 30).
